# Is the lump sum for my cell tower lease worth taking?

> Free cell tower lease buyout calculator: compare a lump-sum offer with the rent you would keep collecting. Present value at your discount rate, the buyer's implied return, colocation upside, tenant-exit risk and an after-tax comparison. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
